individual_objects.label: Left tray material/silhouette at110px
individual_objects.evaluation: At native110px width, the shallow aqua floor, cream rim and lavender front wall remain clear; the complete contour sits on the lower support and stays away from Roshan in all four selected invitations.
individual_objects.refinement: Keep the conserved source; review continuous approach and phone size before binding.

individual_objects.label: Middle tray material/silhouette at110px
individual_objects.evaluation: The exact shared tray is visibly separated from its neighbors and no longer crosses Roshan at the selected pan invitation in either width.
individual_objects.refinement: Retain source; selected clearance is not continuous travel acceptance.

individual_objects.label: Right tray material/silhouette at110px
individual_objects.evaluation: The right reuse keeps a complete rim and matches the other two at native size. It clears the rival and back control.
individual_objects.refinement: Keep the exact reusable tray; confirm the complete approach and device composition.

individual_objects.label: Reused invitation fossil material at105px
individual_objects.evaluation: The conserved golden spiral and lavender stone remain legible at105px and clear Roshan in all four selected invitations at both widths.
individual_objects.refinement: Retain exact source; full fossil action remains independently3.2.

individual_objects.label: Two reused stone supports
individual_objects.evaluation: Both supports retain the source painting and complete contour. Their material fits the props, but the large tray support has excessive empty area, scored separately.
individual_objects.refinement: Keep the painted support source; refine its scale and contents relationship.

individual_objects.label: Reused crystal display beside rival
individual_objects.evaluation: The complete cyan/lavender mineral cluster reads cleanly at130px height below the rival; no flat crystal ring remains in the substituted Library backdrop.
individual_objects.refinement: Preserve source; confirm continuous visibility and actual production binding later.

individual_objects.label: Single ownership of replacement props
individual_objects.evaluation: Each named replacement prop has one drawing owner in this non-runtime substituted Library backdrop; no duplicate flat drawing is visible. The later Opera developer entry is unchanged production.
individual_objects.refinement: Keep exclusive ownership and the explicit route boundary.

individual_objects.label: Roshan/prop travel clearance
individual_objects.evaluation: All eight native invitations show a clear gap between Roshan and the lower fossil, trays and crystal. This improves A1 overlap without changing the actor or gameplay.
individual_objects.refinement: Review all intervening approach frames before transferring the selected-state clearance result to production.

individual_objects.label: Selected working-state prop hiding
individual_objects.evaluation: All selected working canvases hide the invitation props when the actual work surface opens. The fossil, pan and opened rooted geode remain unobscured.
individual_objects.refinement: Continuous hide/reveal and action contact require their own review.

individual_objects.label: Existing room wall/floor/spotlights
individual_objects.evaluation: The same flat angular wall bands, navy field and triangular spotlights remain. Painted props cannot pass this room composition.
individual_objects.refinement: Rebuild the named room weakness using compliant native coverage after inventory; do not claim upsampled resolution as native.

individual_objects.label: Whole invitation placement trial
individual_objects.evaluation: A2 improves actor clearance and retains readable painted props. The oversized empty support and flat room still weaken the whole invitation; current work contact and actions remain below floor.
individual_objects.refinement: Preserve A2 and refine the support arrangement; do not bind or approve the whole job from this trial.

individual_objects.label: Large support versus three small trays
individual_objects.evaluation: At both native widths, the trays use only the lower band of a430×178.5 slab. Its broad empty upper field dominates these small specimens and makes the invitation feel oversized.
individual_objects.refinement: Try three small conserved stone supports, one per tray, with a shared baseline and unchanged tray sources. Capture and review again without altering production.
